title: Track C: approved synthetic source identity and M-B arithmetic review
head: codex/track-c-gsup-v2-2026-10-03
body:
## Result
Records the user-approved M-B method decision and synthetic source identity decision additively. Preserves G-SUP v1 source, Frozen tests/evidence and historical results. Builds on the exact PR #30 combined-integration head 86ad3628dd5c62c6d873e42511e577f24f4fb588; this is a Draft proposal, not canonical completion.

Synthetic source descriptors bind trusted, pre-outcome registered source/vintage/sample identity and unchanged profile/role groups. Reencoding, relabeling and campaign changes cannot bypass consumption under the pinned authority. Durable claim/access intents and fail-closed lineage/provider checks cover crashes, interrupted journals and response mismatches. An identity-only compatibility wrapper delegates the unchanged v1 kernel; it does not activate authoritative M-B v2.

## Verification
Local Python 3.11.16 / NumPy 2.3.5 / pytest 9.1.1 full regression: 1,277 PASS, zero failures/errors/skips (baseline 1,165; 112 new cases). Tested source 3b6ed7eac3fe8f0f852b4d42eb57cf5f3ff497eb; final 675d0d298fbaab5b8473ed048a561ef84e2f3e78 changes only the CI protection guard/path routing. That guard separately passes and preserves 41 exact owner EVL files while permitting precisely six approved additions. Independent diagnostic, adversarial identity tests and unmocked kernel-result invariance are committed. GitHub Actions: PENDING; no CI result is inferred from local PASS.

## Remaining decision
M is approved. Active authoritative M-B v2 is NOT_IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_ARITHMETIC_REDUCTION. Independent fixed-input/Frozen-C6-index counterexamples show fsum p=.10 vs literal NumPy reduction p=.20. Exact historical NumPy version was not recorded. Arithmetic selection materially changes validation results and requires the user's choice; this PR selects none. See implementation/reports/gsup_v2_oracle/ARITHMETIC_REDUCTION_REVIEW_2026-10-03.md.

No actual numeric configuration/defaults, actual CAL_VERIFY access, Holdout consumption, foundation-registry unification, C8 Freeze, publication/Official grant, canonical merge or deployment. Trusted synthetic authority configuration is external to untrusted attempt specs; privileged authority replacement/deletion is outside the protocol threat model.

BRANCH_STATE: descriptor and diagnostics synthetically verified locally. INTEGRATION_STATE: Draft proposal atop PR30, CI pending. CANONICAL_STATE: unchanged b8e39a2196a6d7794a04a0cd5393c68329e126ca. C8 remains SYNTHETIC_VERIFIED / NOT_FROZEN.
